protocol.lifecycle.description: Handshake, prepare/ready, start, pause/resume, dispose and repeated sessions (wire-level only)

gameplay.pause.description: Simulation, timers and audio actually stop while paused

input.back.description: Back/Select requires release and cannot bounce on focus or resume

input.identity.description: Physical controllers retain unique player ownership across reconnect and reversed join order

profile.appearance.description: Name, clothing, skin and drawn face/hat reach the correct character, including live updates

presentation.prewarm.description: Hidden and silent before start; first prepared frame is ready before ready

presentation.frame.description: Packaged game draws a real frame

process.disconnect.description: Packaged game exits cleanly when its host disconnects
